title: Say it right: stress and intonation
objective: Rendre son discours compréhensible grâce à l'accentuation et l'intonation

steps.title: Warm-up: clap the syllables
steps.student_instruction: Clap the syllables of five words: brilliant, exciting, annoying, interesting, boring. Which syllable is strong?
steps.facilitator_instruction: Faire frapper les syllabes et marquer la syllabe accentuée au tableau ; éviter l'accent final « à la française ».

steps.title: Watch: Giving your opinion
steps.student_instruction: Watch Jack and Gemma talk about films. Answer the questions and notice which words they stress.
steps.facilitator_instruction: Montrer la vidéo British Council (QR code) ; sans réseau, lire le script de secours en exagérant les accents. Repérer les adjectifs accentués et l'intonation des questions.

steps.title: Language focus: stress and intonation
steps.student_instruction: Practise: word stress, rising yes/no questions, falling wh- questions.
steps.facilitator_instruction: Gestes de la main (monte / descend) ; faire répéter en chœur puis individuellement.

steps.title: Differentiated practice
steps.student_instruction: Complete your A, B or C sheet, then read your sentences to a partner.
steps.facilitator_instruction: A : souligner les syllabes accentuées ; B : marquer l'intonation de questions ; C : écrire et jouer une critique de film.

steps.title: Perform a film review
steps.student_instruction: In pairs, perform a 6-line film review dialogue. Your partner checks stress and intonation.
steps.facilitator_instruction: Fiche d'observation simple (3 adjectifs, 2 questions) ; enregistrer si possible pour réécoute.

steps.title: Exit ticket
steps.student_instruction: Write one adjective with its stressed syllable in capitals.
steps.facilitator_instruction: Ramasser ; noter les mots à retravailler.

sheets.student_content: Underline the stressed syllable: brilliant - exciting - annoying - interesting - boring - amazing.
sheets.facilitator_correction: BRIL-liant ; ex-CI-ting ; an-NOY-ing ; IN-teresting ; BOR-ing ; a-MA-zing.

sheets.student_content: Mark each question with up or down, then read them aloud: Was it good? / What did you see? / Did you like it? / Who was in it?
sheets.facilitator_correction: Was it good? up ; What did you see? down ; Did you like it? up ; Who was in it? down.

sheets.student_content: Write a 6-line dialogue reviewing a film, with three adjectives in capitals for stress, two yes/no questions and one wh- question. Perform it.
sheets.facilitator_correction: Production libre ; critères : accent de mot correct, intonation montante / descendante adaptée, ton expressif.

criteria: L'élève place correctement l'accent de mot
L'élève adapte l'intonation au type de question
L'élève est compris par un camarade sans répétition

common_errors: Intonation montante sur toutes les questions
